contracts_mapped.name: bn
contracts_mapped.description: It is the numeric Adform banner ID. Adform documents video tags as `{region}.adform.net/videoad/?bn=` plus that ID. a2 is the Americas tracking domain, track is EMEA, a1 is global, asia is APAC.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Set `bn` to the banner ID from the Adform tag.

contracts_mapped.name: C
contracts_mapped.description: It is the click index Adform writes on multi-click banners. Adform documents clicktrackers as `C=1`, `C=2`, and so on. Single-click tags omit it.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Set `C` to the click index from the Adform tag, or drop the pair on a single-click tag.

source_conflicts.observation: XDM quantity is integer. The AppMeasurement products guide describes quantity without an integer-only restriction.

contracts_mapped.name: vstevt
contracts_mapped.description: It is the Firefly viewability event code on Amazon-hosted DoubleVerify hops. Amazon documents DSP third-party verification with DoubleVerify, not this query; generated /dv/event.png and /dv/proxy tags always send vstevt, so an empty or missing value is a truncated wrapper.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Export the Firefly VAST again from Amazon DSP so vstevt is present on the /dv/ hop.

contracts_mapped.name: ctx
contracts_mapped.description: It is the DoubleVerify context or advertiser key. Google documents it as ctx inside dvparams. Generated /dv/proxy tags carry the same name. Quartile /dv/event.png hops often omit it.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Keep ctx from the generated Firefly /dv/proxy tag, or drop the empty pair.

contracts_mapped.name: cmp

contracts_mapped.name: sid

contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Keep sid from the generated Firefly /dv/proxy tag, or drop the empty pair.

Official SDK source retrieved directly after browser reader could not load JavaScript. vendor_rule_inventory: Network/site/asset identity alternatives and profile/capabilities.
SDK mapped network/fallback IDs, duration/time/random numbers, IPv4 visitor, positive subsession, visitor/location/mode fields, and semicolon-delimited temporal slots.
Official SDK serializes cana as candidate ID CSV and resolves symbolic request modes to on-demand/live and duration types to exact/variable.

Type B request group 0 carries global fields, group 1 carries targeting key values, and later raw semicolon groups carry individual temporal/display slots. Temporal slots have ptgt=a; display scanner defaults to ptgt=s. Percent-encoded semicolons remain field content.

Global network/site contracts evaluate only query group0. Group1 targeting keys cannot satisfy globals or SDK slot dependencies. Legacy flat and partial VMAP group1 slot inputs retain optional checks.

SDK temporal slots with ptgt=a in groups2 onward require their own slid/slau/tpos, nonnegative tpos, and distinct literal slid across temporal groups. Display ptgt=s groups need no temporal fields and do not share temporal uniqueness.
Official SDK executes fractional live tokens and string fallback IDs. Integer-shape differences now receive advisory severity, preserving documented positive token minimum1.

contracts_mapped.description: ID5 accepts a JSON object as its request body.

contracts_mapped.name: partner
contracts_mapped.description: It is the ID5 Partner Number. ID5 documents partner as required on /ga/v1.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Set partner to the Partner Number ID5 issued. Use 173 only while testing.

contracts_mapped.name: ts
contracts_mapped.description: It is the request timestamp. ID5 documents ts as required, as an ISO-8601 string with a time zone offset.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Set ts to an ISO-8601 timestamp with offset, such as 2013-02-01T12:52:34+09:00.

contracts_mapped.name: bundle
contracts_mapped.description: It is the app identifier. ID5 documents bundle as required: package name on Android, numeric ID on iOS.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Set bundle to the app package name or iOS numeric ID.

contracts_mapped.name: ver
contracts_mapped.description: It is the application version. ID5 documents ver as required.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Set ver to the app version string.

contracts_mapped.name: ip
contracts_mapped.description: It is the IPv4 address closest to the device. ID5 documents ip as required.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send the device-facing IPv4 address, unhashed.

contracts_mapped.name: ua
contracts_mapped.description: It is the device default-browser user agent. ID5 documents ua as required.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send the raw user agent string, unhashed.

contracts_mapped.name: hem
contracts_mapped.description: It is a SHA-256 hash of the cleansed email. ID5 documents hem as sha256 when present.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Normalize and SHA-256 hash the identifier, then send its 64-character hexadecimal digest.

contracts_mapped.name: phone
contracts_mapped.description: It is a SHA-256 hash of the cleansed phone number.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Normalize and SHA-256 hash the identifier, then send its 64-character hexadecimal digest.

contracts_mapped.name: provider
contracts_mapped.description: ID5 documents provider as an optional string request field.

contracts_mapped.name: signature
contracts_mapped.description: ID5 documents signature as an optional string request field.

contracts_mapped.name: gdpr_consent
contracts_mapped.description: ID5 documents gdpr_consent as an optional string request field.

contracts_mapped.name: gpp_string
contracts_mapped.description: ID5 documents gpp_string as an optional string request field.

contracts_mapped.name: region
contracts_mapped.description: ID5 accepts ISO 3166-2 subdivision codes, or a two-letter state code for the USA.

contracts_mapped.name: city
contracts_mapped.description: ID5 names the UN/LOCODE format, two country letters followed by three letters or digits 2 through 9.

contracts_mapped.name: accept_language
contracts_mapped.description: ID5 requires compatibility with the browser Accept-Language header. RFC 9110 and RFC 4647 define basic language ranges and optional quality weights from 0 to 1 with at most three fractional digits.

contracts_mapped.name: gdpr
contracts_mapped.description: ID5 documents 1 when GDPR applies and 0 otherwise.

contracts_mapped.name: allowed_vendors
contracts_mapped.description: ID5 documents allowed_vendors as an array of vendor identifier strings.

contracts_mapped.description: ID5 accepts ID5-prefixed partner identifiers or numeric IAB vendor IDs.

contracts_mapped.name: us_privacy
contracts_mapped.description: ID5 accepts the IAB US Privacy String.

contracts_mapped.name: gpp_sid
contracts_mapped.description: ID5 allows one GPP section ID or at most two comma-separated section IDs.

contracts_mapped.name: idfv
contracts_mapped.description: ID5 documents the Apple vendor identifier in UUID format.

contracts_mapped.name: ipv6
contracts_mapped.description: ID5 documents ipv6 as the device IPv6 address.

contracts_mapped.name: country
contracts_mapped.description: ID5 documents country as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code.

contracts_mapped.name: segments
contracts_mapped.description: ID5 documents segments as an array of objects.

contracts_mapped.name: segments[]
contracts_mapped.description: Every ID5 segment entry is an object.

contracts_mapped.name: name
contracts_mapped.description: ID5 documents name as an optional string request field.

contracts_mapped.name: domain
contracts_mapped.description: ID5 documents domain as an optional string request field.

contracts_mapped.name: puid
contracts_mapped.description: ID5 documents puid as an optional string request field.

contracts_mapped.name: maid

assertions_mapped.message: A field carries what looks like a raw email address. ID5 documents hem as a SHA-256 digest of a cleansed email.

contracts_mapped.name: id
contracts_mapped.description: It is the Monetize conversion pixel ID. Microsoft documents id on every exported conversion pixel.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Set id to the conversion pixel ID from Monetize.

contracts_mapped.name: t
contracts_mapped.description: It is the pixel type. Microsoft documents t=1 for JavaScript and t=2 for image.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Set t=2 on an image pixel, or t=1 on a JavaScript pixel.

contracts_mapped.name: order_id
contracts_mapped.description: It is an order ID or SKU. Microsoft documents letters and numbers, with a 36 character limit.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Set order_id to the order or SKU, letters and numbers only, at most 36 characters.

contracts_mapped.name: value
contracts_mapped.description: It is the dynamic revenue. Microsoft documents a purely numerical value, so 10 is valid and $10 is not.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Set value to a number with no currency symbol, such as 10 or 10.50.

contracts_mapped.name: consent
contracts_mapped.description: It is binary consent when TCF signals are not available. Microsoft documents 1 for granted and 0 for denied.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send consent=1 when the user granted consent, or consent=0 when they denied it.

contracts_mapped.name: other
contracts_mapped.description: It is extra external data on the conversion. Microsoft documents letters and numbers, with a 20 character limit.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Set other to letters and numbers only, at most 20 characters.

contracts_mapped.name: redir
contracts_mapped.description: It is a piggyback pixel URL. Microsoft documents redir as the image or JavaScript pixel to notify after conversion.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Set redir to an absolute image or JavaScript pixel URL, matching the host pixel type.

contracts_mapped.name: seg
contracts_mapped.description: It adds the user to one or more segments when the conversion fires. Microsoft documents comma-separated segment IDs on the same conversion pixel.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Set `seg` to one or more integer segment IDs, comma-separated, such as `12192,12304`.

contracts_mapped.name: remove
contracts_mapped.description: It removes the user from one or more segments when the conversion fires. Microsoft documents comma-separated segment IDs on the same conversion pixel.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Set `remove` to one or more integer segment IDs, comma-separated, such as `23145`.
